title: OpenWrt fault-injection platform
summary: Designed an OpenWrt-based fault-injection platform that recreated Wi-Fi, DHCP, DNS, routing, port-blocking, and cloud-connectivity failures, turning intermittent device issues into repeatable engineering test cases for unattended regression runs.
highlights: Drove root-cause analysis of field-reported defects and exercised TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP troubleshooting on Linux.
note: Written up from internal work. The company repository is private, so there is no public code.
